Image 5: The University of South Florida and Tampa Fire Rescue conducted a a randomized controlled trial to assess the effectiveness of a worksite exercise regimen targeted to reduce the risk of low back injury and disability in firefighters. One method to improve the design quality and conduct of clinical trials is the use of pilot studies. Pilot studies should test key elements of the trial, including recruitment and retention strategies, intervention delivery, data collection methods and adherence to the study protocol.
